archetypes.name: The Grounded Builder
archetypes.description: Square palm with clear, deep lines. Enduring, reliable, highly practical, and closely connected to the physical world.

archetypes.name: The Strategic Visionary
archetypes.description: Square palm with long fingers and intricate branching lines. Analytical, curious, articulate, and driven by intellectual discovery.

archetypes.name: The Passionate Catalyst
archetypes.description: Oblong palm with shorter fingers and vibrant, energetic line patterns. Dynamic, charismatic, spontaneous, and an innate leader.

archetypes.name: The Intuitive Empath
archetypes.description: Long palm with long fingers and delicate, flowing lines. Deeply perceptive, imaginative, empathetic, and attuned to spiritual currents.

life_long_curved.title: Vibrant Resilience & Vitality
life_long_curved.summary: A gracefully sweeping arc encircling the Venus mount indicates rich stamina, an open heart to life experience, and strong recuperative energy.
life_long_curved.detailed: Your life line exhibits a wide, generous curve. In traditional palmistry, this represents a life lived with gusto, enthusiasm, and an expansive personal space. You thrive in vibrant environments and possess natural physical resilience.
life_long_curved.guidance: Channel your robust life-force into creative pursuits and protect your boundaries against energy drain.

life_straight_short.title: Focused & Deliberate Energy
life_straight_short.summary: A closer, direct trajectory reflects conscious energy conservation, self-reliance, and cautious deliberation.
life_straight_short.detailed: This formation indicates selective vitality. You prefer to conserve your energy for what truly matters rather than spreading yourself thin. Note that in genuine palmistry, length does not denote lifespan, but the tempo and distribution of energy.
life_straight_short.guidance: Incorporate deliberate rest and avoid overextending in high-stimulation social settings.

life_deep_unbroken.title: Steadfast Constitution
life_deep_unbroken.summary: A well-etched, clean trench shows unwavering inner fortitude and emotional grounding.
life_deep_unbroken.detailed: A deeply marked life line symbolizes an anchor of calm in stormy situations. You recover swiftly from setbacks and provide stability to those around you.
life_deep_unbroken.guidance: Use your steadfast strength to mentor and anchor others while maintaining your personal vision.

life_forked_end.title: Explorer's Horizon
life_forked_end.summary: A fork near the wrist is traditionally called the Traveler's Fork, suggesting wanderlust or relocation.
life_forked_end.detailed: A terminal branch on the life line points toward a dual nature: a desire for rooted comfort balanced with an undeniable yearning for exploration, new cultures, or spiritual journeys.
life_forked_end.guidance: Embrace travel and periodic renewal of your home environment.

heart_curved_jupiter.title: Idealistic & Compassionate Heart
heart_curved_jupiter.summary: An upward sweeping heart line terminating under the Jupiter mount reveals high relational standards and profound loyalty.
heart_curved_jupiter.detailed: You bring a noble, generous warmth to all relationships. You seek meaningful soulful partnerships and hold elevated ideals about devotion, integrity, and mutual respect.
heart_curved_jupiter.guidance: Ensure your high ideals allow room for human vulnerability and imperfect beauty.

heart_straight_saturn.title: Pragmatic & Discerning Love
heart_straight_saturn.summary: A more horizontal heart line ending near Saturn reflects emotional self-control, composure, and sensible boundaries.
heart_straight_saturn.detailed: You evaluate emotions with clarity and practicality. You prefer steady, reliable commitments over dramatic gestures, valuing dependability and shared tangible goals.
heart_straight_saturn.guidance: Allow yourself to express soft affection openly to help loved ones feel cherished.

heart_deep_passionate.title: Deep Emotional Immersion
heart_deep_passionate.summary: A strongly defined heart furrow shows intense emotional capacity and authentic empathy.
heart_deep_passionate.detailed: Your emotional world is rich and textured. You feel deeply and connect intimately with art, nature, and heartfelt conversation.
heart_deep_passionate.guidance: Regular meditation or creative expression helps balance emotional intensity.

head_sloping_creative.title: Imaginative & Intuitive Mind
head_sloping_creative.summary: A head line gently inclining toward the Lunar mount denotes rich imagination, lateral problem solving, and artistic intuition.
head_sloping_creative.detailed: Your mind thrives beyond rigid boundaries. You synthesize concepts through intuition, visual thinking, and emotional resonance. You excel in design, storytelling, and conceptual innovation.
head_sloping_creative.guidance: Pair your expansive creative ideas with tangible deadlines and structured execution.

head_straight_analytical.title: Logical & Strategic Intellect
head_straight_analytical.summary: A linear, direct trajectory across the palm signifies methodical thinking, objectivity, and precise discernment.
head_straight_analytical.detailed: You are a master of clarity and evidence. When faced with complexity, you dissect issues logically, eliminating bias and discovering efficient practical pathways.
head_straight_analytical.guidance: Cultivate moments of playful spontaneity to complement your structured brilliance.

head_forked_writer.title: The Versatile Dual Mind (Writer's Fork)
head_forked_writer.summary: A bifurcated head line terminal combines analytical discernment with imaginative vision.
head_forked_writer.detailed: Often referred to as the Lawyer's or Writer's Fork, this rare marking provides the ability to perceive both sides of any debate and translate abstract concepts into persuasive communication.
head_forked_writer.guidance: Take up writing, teaching, or leadership roles where synthesis is vital.

fate_prominent_direct.title: Definite Purpose & Clear Trajectory
fate_prominent_direct.summary: A distinct vertical furrow straight up toward Saturn indicates self-driven dedication and clear professional goals.
fate_prominent_direct.detailed: You have a strong sense of destiny and personal agency. You chart your course deliberately and take personal ownership over your achievements.
fate_prominent_direct.guidance: Remember that life's journey also benefits from unplanned serendipity.

fate_flexible_faint.title: Adaptive & Multipotentialite Path
fate_flexible_faint.summary: A lighter or flexible fate line suggests freedom from rigid tracks, opening doors to diverse reinventions.
fate_flexible_faint.detailed: Rather than a singular narrow path, your journey is characterized by multiple chapters, evolving passions, and agile reinvention. You are the architect of your own evolving career.
fate_flexible_faint.guidance: Celebrate each phase of your career as valuable cumulative wisdom.

mounts.jupiter: Ambition, leadership instincts, noble dignity, and desire to make a lasting social impact.
mounts.saturn: Patience, philosophical depth, introspective wisdom, and affinity for solitary research.
mounts.apollo: Aesthetic refinement, creative expression, optimism, and appreciation for beauty and harmony.
mounts.mercury: Agile communication, business acumen, quick wit, and scientific curiosity.
mounts.venus: Sensory delight, vitality, warm affection, and joy in human connection.
mounts.moon: Subconscious intuition, dream recall, mystical affinity, and imaginative depth.
mounts.mars: Moral courage, physical perseverance, resilience against adversity, and assertive energy.
